title: Shelf with labelled covered measuring jugs and supplies
objects_and_counts: No people are visible in the photographed scene.

At least five clear plastic measuring jugs/pitchers are visible on the top shelf; several are covered with clear cling film or plastic wrap and have handwritten labels on the covers. (These jugs are on the top shelf; some are partially cropped by the image edges.)
One black rectangular notebook or thin black box is on the top shelf at the front right of the image; it bears a small white barcode/label.
One roll of multicoloured patterned paper towel (vertical, upright) stands near the rear right of the top shelf.
One metal two-shelf utility cart (white painted frame) forms the structure holding the items; its handle and part of its side are visible at the right edge of the image.
On the lower shelf there are at least three large sacks/bags (white and red/white and blue) stacked; one bag shows a printed '20 KG' marking.
A partially visible cardboard box is at the left edge of the top shelf and obscures part of the scene.
A yellow pallet or piece of yellow material is visible at the lower right floor area near the cart; a hand truck or trolley handle is visible behind the cart on the right.

The covered measuring jugs are grouped toward the left and center of the top shelf; several are adjacent to one another and some are partially overlapping when viewed from above.
The black notebook/box lies flat on the top shelf toward the front right of the top shelf, separated from the jugs by a small clear area of the shelf surface.
A paper-towel roll stands upright behind and to the right of the jugs, closer to the rear edge of the top shelf.
Large sacks/bags rest on the lower shelf directly beneath the jugs and occupy most of the visible lower-shelf area; a cardboard box is at the leftmost top-shelf edge and abuts the leftmost jug.
colours_and_materials: The top shelf surface is white and appears to be painted metal or laminated material.
The measuring jugs are clear/translucent plastic and are covered with transparent cling film or plastic wrap with handwritten black ink on the wrap.
The notebook/box on the top shelf is matte black with a small white label or barcode sticker.
There are white sacks with red and blue printed areas on the lower shelf; one sack shows a prominent blue panel and another shows red printing.
A cardboard box with brown corrugated texture is visible at the left edge; a portion of a yellow floor pallet or painted floor area is visible at the lower right.
uncertainties: Exact count of the covered measuring jugs is uncertain due to partial cropping and overlap; at least five distinct jugs are visually identifiable, but more could be present off-frame.
